title: Utillian 50 Auto Draw 510 Battery
description:
The Utillian 50 510 Battery has a few special features that have been tweaked to make sessions as convenient as possible. The first is an airflow sensor, which activates the heating element as soon as it registers your inhalation. The U50 Vape also comes with an automatic preheating function that supplies a lower voltage to the heating element for 15 seconds, essentially preparing your heating chamber for the upcoming session.

If you’re looking for a high-quality 510 thread battery that can give you great results without any complicated operations, the Utillian 50 is just what you need. It offers four different temperature settings, ranging from 2.6 Volts to 3.8V. You can easily see the current temperature range displayed by an LED at the bottom of the unit. With its intuitive design, the U50 is the ideal companion for those who are always on the go.

Key Features:
Intuitive Use
Feature Rich
15 Second Pre Heat
Lightweight Pen Style Vape
Draw flow Sensor
